accounting_rules.expansion_reconciliation: Exclude subcampaign transfer rows from the parent, use child operation costs once. Initial and expansion operation ID sets were disjoint. Aggregate model and held amounts matched every published recipe cost sample exactly.
accounting_rules.hardware_basis: Configured resources and started/stopped worker lifetime, not measured CPU/GPU utilization or end-to-end task latency. Workers are shared across candidates; lifetimes include setup, idle time and repairs.
accounting_rules.recipe_pilot: Earlier API costs and five-task solver samples are nested inside the initial program ledger; do not add them again. Equal allocation of shared compute and old forecasts were deliberately excluded.
accounting_rules.stage_basis: Stage names for recipe expansion are operation-ID prefixes. A build stage can include initial generation and repair; a design stage can include screening/retries. These are cost buckets, not distinct task counts.
accounting_rules.token_basis: Reported input/output and cache fields from recoverable settled LiteLLM receipts; cache fields are subsets, never extra tokens to add. Unknown/failed responses lack usage and retain budget holds. Cost aggregation uses stored ledger charges rather than repricing these token totals.
